questions.q: What does AO3 'Develop' ask you to do in Cambridge IGCSE Art & Design?
options: Develop ideas through investigation, demonstrating critical understanding
questions.why: AO3 is 'Develop ideas through investigation, demonstrating critical understanding'.

options: Your own sketch made in a gallery
questions.why: First-hand sources are made or seen by you, such as your own drawings and photographs.

questions.q: Which research page shows the strongest critical understanding?
options: A pasted picture with the title
A copy of the artwork with no comment
A study in the artist's style, notes on how it works, and a new piece applying it to your theme
questions.why: Examiners want analysis, a study, and a visible link to your own developed idea.

questions.q: Explain how you would use one real artist's work to develop a project on 'The city'.
questions.model: Choose an artist such as Basquiat or Hockney, describe real features (rough line and text, or flat bright colour), make a small study in that style, then apply the method to your own photos of the city and explain the link.
points: names a real artist with an accurate feature of their work
makes or describes a study in their style
applies it to the theme with your own source
says why it suits the idea
